messages.text: One important platform-specific invariant emerged: on Windows, default hidden filtering is based on file attributes, and files created under the hidden `.tura` directory inherited hidden status in the probe. I’ll avoid baking that artifact into the port by generating verifier fixtures outside hidden parents and by honoring Windows hidden attributes where available.

+    out: list[object] = []
+    for part in parts:
+        if part.isdigit():

+        else:
+            out.append((1, part))
+    return out

+def cmp_entries(opts: Options, a: Entry, b: Entry) -> int:
+    field = opts.sort
+    if field == "none":
+        return 0
+    if field == "size":
+        av, bv = a.size_value(), b.size_value()
+        return (av > bv) - (av < bv)
+    if field in ("modified", "changed", "accessed", "created", "age"):
+        getter = {"modified": Entry.mtime, "changed": Entry.ctime, "created": Entry.ctime, "accessed": Entry.atime, "age": Entry.mtime}[field]
+        av, bv = getter(a), getter(b)
+        if field == "age":
+            av, bv = bv, av
+        return (av > bv) - (av < bv)
+    if field == "extension":
+        ae = extension(a.name)
+        be = extension(b.name)
+        if ae != be:
+            return (ae > be) - (ae < be)
+    if field == "type":
+        at, bt = type_rank(a), type_rank(b)
+        if at != bt:
+            return (at > bt) - (at < bt)
+    an = a.name[1:] if field == "mix-hidden" and a.name.startswith(".") else a.name
+    bn = b.name[1:] if field == "mix-hidden" and b.name.startswith(".") else b.name

+    if e.is_file():

+    if e.is_symlink():

+

+    if is_windows() and e.name.startswith("_"):
